items.title: Brand Guidelines
items.description: Official logo usage, asset rules, and trademark guidance for media and partners.

sections.heading: Logo clear space
paragraphs: Maintain clear space around the SeaDays logo equal to at least the height of the anchor mark in the wordmark. Never crowd the logo with text, borders, or competing graphics.

sections.heading: Allowed logo versions
list: App icon for store and product references
SVG for web and large-format print

sections.heading: Logo misuse — do not
list: Stretch, skew, or rotate the logo
Change logo colors outside the approved palette
Place the logo on busy backgrounds without sufficient contrast
Add effects such as shadows, outlines, or gradients

sections.heading: Screenshots
paragraphs: App screenshots may be used in editorial coverage and reviews with attribution to SeaDays. Do not crop screenshots in ways that misrepresent product functionality.

sections.heading: Marketing images
paragraphs: Marketing images may be used when referencing or reporting on SeaDays. Do not imply endorsement, partnership, or sponsorship without written approval.

sections.heading: Trademark & copyright
paragraphs: SeaDays® is a trademark of SeaDays. All brand assets remain the property of SeaDays.

items.title: Color Palette
items.description: Approved SeaDays brand colors for digital press, social, and marketing references.

colors.name: White
colors.usage: Primary text on dark, light logo variants

colors.name: Teal
colors.usage: Calm UI surfaces and supporting accents

sections.heading: Usage notes
paragraphs: SeaDays Red is the primary accent and should lead calls to action, highlights, and brand moments.
Use Deep Black and White as the core contrast pair across the website, app marketing, and dark UI compositions.
Secondary colors support feature storytelling and data visualization. They should not replace SeaDays Red as the primary brand accent.

items.title: Typography Guide
items.description: Type standards that match the SeaDays website and product marketing.

sections.heading: Primary typeface
paragraphs: System UI stack: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

sections.heading: Headings
paragraphs: Use bold weights (700–900) with tight letter-spacing for hero headlines and section titles.
Homepage-style hero headlines use large, high-contrast white type on dark backgrounds.

sections.heading: Body text
paragraphs: Use regular to medium weights at 16–18px base size with 1.6–1.8 line height.
Supporting copy should use softened white or gray tones on dark backgrounds for readability.

sections.heading: Usage notes
paragraphs: Use the system UI stack for all web and marketing materials referencing SeaDays unless SeaDays provides a campaign-specific template.
Avoid decorative, script, or serif fonts when representing the app interface or official product marketing.
